item.title: Samsung Electronics labor and management reach broad agreement on 'institutionalizing performance bonuses'... Central Labor Commission chair says "only one issue remains" (삼전 노사 ‘성과급 제도화’ 큰 틀 합의…중노위원장 “한가지 쟁점만 남아”)
item.description:
The failure of Samsung Electronics labor and management to reach an agreement on the 19th after more than 14 hours of relay negotiations appears to be due to their inability to narrow differences over detailed requirements. While they agreed on the broad direction of "a significant temporary expansion of performance bonus payments," further discussion is still needed. As labor and management will sit down at the negotiating table again on the 20th, attention is focused on whether a major compromise can be reached the day before the scheduled strike date (the 21st). (19일 삼성전자 노사가 14시간을 넘는 릴레이 협상에서 합의에 이르지 못한 건 세부 요건을 놓고 이견을 좁히지 못했기 때문으로 보인다. ‘한시적인 성과급 지급 대폭 확대’라는 큰 방향에는 의견을 모았지만 추가 논의가 필요한 상황이다. 20일에도 노사가 협상 테이블에 앉는 만큼, 파업 예고일(21일)을 하루 앞두고 대타협이 이뤄질 수 있을지 주목된다.)

Samsung Electronics labor and management attended the second post-mediation meeting held at the Central Labor Commission (CLC) in the Government Complex Sejong from 10 a.m. on this day. CLC Chairperson Park Su-geun set a 7 p.m. deadline for negotiations, but both sides failed to reach a conclusion even past midnight. This is why the CLC announced shortly after midnight that "the third post-mediation meeting will resume at 10 a.m. on the 20th." Chairperson Park, who oversaw the mediation, explained, "Labor and management could not agree on one issue," adding, "Most points have been established, but one remains unresolved, so the employer side will finalize its position and return." ( 삼성전자 노사는 이날 오전 10시부터 정부 세종청사 중앙노동위원회(중노위)에서 열린 2차 사후조정 회의에 참석했다. 박수근 중노위원장은 이날 저녁 7시를 협상 시한으로 못 박았지만 노사 양쪽은 자정을 넘기도록 결론을 내지 못했다. 중노위가 0시를 넘긴 시각에 “20일 오전 10시부터 3차 사후조정 회의를 속개할 예정”이라고 밝힌 이유다. 조정을 맡은 박 위원장은 “노사가 한 가지 쟁점에 대해서 일치하지 못했다”며 “대부분 정립됐고 하나가 정리가 안 돼서 사용자 쪽이 최종적으로 입장을 정리해서 오기로 했다”고 설명했다. )

On this day, Samsung Electronics labor and management presented revised proposals regarding the institutionalization of performance bonuses, seeking common ground. The union demanded institutionalization based on allocating 15% of each division's operating profit as the performance bonus pool and abolishing the existing cap on performance bonuses, which is up to 50% of an individual's annual salary. In contrast, the company side took the position of offering an industry-leading "special performance bonus" to semiconductor division employees, based on a pool of at least 10% of operating profit. On the key issue of institutionalizing new performance bonus criteria, the company side stepped back by proposing a "temporary three-year application." ( 삼성전자 노사는 이날 성과급 제도화를 놓고 수정안을 제시하며 접점을 찾아갔다. 노조는 부문별 영업이익의 15%를 성과급 재원으로 하고, 개인 연봉의 50%까지인 기존 성과급 상한을 폐지하는 내용의 제도화를 요구했다. 반면 사쪽은 영업이익의 10% 이상의 재원을 토대로 반도체 부문 직원들에게 업계 최고 수준의 ‘특별 성과급’을 지급하겠다는 입장이었다. 핵심 쟁점인 새 성과급 기준 제도화를 두고는 사쪽이 ‘3년 한시적 적용’을 제안하는 등 한발 물러섰다. )

The method of distributing performance bonuses within each business division was also a major point of contention. The union demanded that 70% of the performance bonus pool for the semiconductor division (DS) be distributed across the entire division, with the remaining 30% allocated based on the performance of each business unit. However, the company side argued that giving larger bonuses to the foundry (semiconductor contract manufacturing) and System LSI business units, which are non-memory divisions posting losses, runs counter to meritocracy and proposed lowering the overall distribution ratio. The company side countered by suggesting that 60% of the performance bonus pool be distributed across the entire semiconductor division and 40% to each business unit. ( 각 사업 부문 내 성과급 배분 방식도 주요 쟁점이었다. 노조는 반도체 부문(DS) 성과급 재원의 70%를 전체에 배분한 뒤, 30%를 사업 부문별 실적에 따라 나누자고 요구했다. 하지만 회사 쪽은 적자를 내는 비메모리 사업부인 파운드리(반도체 수탁생산) 및 시스템엘에스아이(LSI) 사업부에 많은 성과급을 주는 건 성과주의에 역행한다며 전체 배분율을 낮추자고 했다. 사쪽은 성과급 배분 비율을 반도체 부문 전체 60%, 각 사업부 40%로 하자고 맞섰다. )

On this day, labor and management reportedly focused their discussions on how to set the percentage of annual operating profit used as the employee performance bonus pool and a plan to temporarily remove the individual performance bonus cap. The distribution ratio of the performance bonus pool within the semiconductor division was also discussed as a key issue. Additionally, the company's previously stated prerequisites for paying performance bonuses—such as "achieving an annual operating profit of over 20 trillion won in the semiconductor division" and "achieving the top spot in domestic industry sales and operating profit"—were put on the negotiating table. Earlier, the union side reportedly indicated during a meeting with Samsung Electronics management on the 15th that they could reach an agreement if these conditions for paying performance bonuses were removed. ( 이날 노사는 직원 성과급 재원으로 사용하는 연간 영업이익의 비율을 어떻게 정할지와 개인별 성과급 상한을 한시적으로 없애는 방안을 집중적으로 논의한 것으로 알려졌다. 반도체 부문 내 성과급 재원 배분 비율도 핵심 쟁점 중 하나로 논의됐다. 또 회사 쪽이 기존에 성과급 지급의 전제 조건으로 내걸었던 “반도체 부문 연간 영업이익 200조원 이상 달성”, “국내 업계 매출액 및 영업이익 1위 달성” 등도 협상 테이블에 올랐다. 앞서 노조 쪽은 지난 15일 삼성전자 경영진과의 면담에서도 이같은 성과급 지급의 조건을 없애면 합의할 수 있다는 입장을 내비친 것으로 알려졌다. )

Some progress in the negotiations on this day is diagnosed as stemming from the government's unprecedented intervention in the Samsung Electronics labor issue, including pressure from President Lee Jae-myung for a settlement, which left the company side effectively cornered. The company appeared unable to resolve its labor issues internally and was pulled along by external forces, ultimately being driven toward a settlement by accommodating the union's demands as much as possible. The government reportedly intensified its involvement by sending Employment and Labor Minister Kim Young-hoon to the negotiation site on this day. ( 이날 협상이 일부 진전을 보인 것은 이재명 대통령까지 협상 타결을 압박하는 등 정부가 삼성전자 노사 문제에 이례적으로 팔을 걷어붙이면서 사쪽이 사실상 코너에 몰렸기 때문이라는 진단이 나온다. 회사의 노사 문제를 자체적으로 해결하지 못하고 외부에 끌려다니는 모습을 보이며 결국 노조 쪽 요구를 최대한 수용하면서 협상 타결 쪽으로 내몰렸다는 것이다. 정부는 이날 김영훈 고용노동부 장관을 협상 현장에 보내며 개입을 강화한 것으로 전해졌다. )

With the union having announced a strike scheduled for the 21st, the third mediation meeting on the 20th is effectively the final negotiation. Samsung Electronics sent an official document to the Samsung Group Enterprise-level Union's Samsung Electronics Branch and the National Samsung Electronics Labor Union, which are leading the labor-management negotiations, notifying them that "a total of 7,087 people, including 2,396 for safety tasks and 4,691 for security work, must report to work normally during the strike period." This measure follows the Suwon District Court's partial acceptance of the company's request for a temporary injunction against the union to prohibit illegal strike actions, filed the previous day. ( 노조가 오는 21일 파업을 예고하고 있는 만큼, 20일에 열리는 3차 조정은 사실상 마지막 협상이다. 삼성전자는 이날 노사 협상을 이끄는 삼성그룹 초기업노동조합 삼성전자지부(초기업노조)와 전국삼성전자노동조합(전삼노)에 공문을 보내 “파업 기간 중 안전 업무 2396명, 보안 작업 4691명 등 모두 7087명이 정상 출근해야 한다”고 통보했다. 이는 전날 수원지법이 회사가 노조를 상대로 제기한 ‘위법 쟁의행위 금지 가처분’ 신청을 일부 인용한 데 따른 조처다. )

item.title: All Banks Earned 15.8 Trillion Won in Interest Income in Q1…2.3 Trillion Won in FX Gains (1분기 전체 은행이 벌어들인 이자이익 15.8조원…환율이익 2.3조원)
item.description:
In the first quarter, the total interest income (loan interest revenue minus deposit interest expense) earned by all 20 domestic banks amounted to 15.8 trillion won, an increase of 1 trillion won compared to the same period last year. This was due to higher loan interest rates, while the interest expenses paid to customers on deposits and savings decreased. (지난 1분기 국내 20개 전체 은행이 벌어들인 이자이익(여신 이자수익-수신 이자비용)이 총 15조8천억원으로 전년 동기대비 1조원 더 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 대출금리는 높아진 반면, 고객 예·적금에 지급한 이자비용은 줄어든 덕분이다.)

According to the preliminary data on domestic bank business performance for the first quarter of this year released by the Financial Supervisory Service on the 20th, the combined interest income of all domestic banks (commercial banks + specialized banks) totaled 15.8 trillion won, up 1 trillion won from the same period last year. Interest income from loan assets was 35.1 trillion won, while interest expenses paid on deposits and savings stood at 19.3 trillion won. Despite interest income from loans decreasing by 1.6 trillion won compared to the same period last year (36.7 trillion won), interest expenses paid to depositors fell by 2.5 trillion won from the same period last year (21.8 trillion won). ( 20일 금융감독원이 발표한 올해 1분기 국내은행 영업실적(잠정) 자료를 보면, 국내 전체 은행(일반은행+특수은행)의 합산 이자이익은 총 15조8천억원으로 전년 동기에 견줘 1조원 증가했다. 대출자산에서 번 이자수익은 35조1천억원, 예적금 등에 내준 이자비용은 19조3천억원이다. 대출로 벌어들인 이자수익이 전년 동기(36조7천억원)에 비해 1조6천억원 감소했음에도 예금고객에게 지급한 이자비용이 전년동기(21조8천억원)보다 2조5천억원 줄어든 덕분이다. )

Due to rising market interest rates increasing loan rates, while deposit and savings rates remained low, the net interest margin (NIM, at 1.56%) also improved by 0.03 percentage points compared to the same period last year. Interest-earning assets such as loan bonds (3,556 trillion won) also increased by 162.1 trillion won (4.8%) year-on-year. ( 시장금리 상승으로 대출금리가 오른 반면 예적금 금리는 낮은 수준을 유지해 순이자마진(NIM·1.56%)도 전년동기대비 0.03%포인트 좋아졌다. 대출채권 등 이자수익을 내는 자산(3556조원)도 전년동기 대비 162조1천억원(4.8%) 증가했다.)

The net profit of all domestic banks in the first quarter was 6.7 trillion won, down 300 billion won (3.9%) from the same period last year. Among these, the net profit of commercial banks (including city, regional, and internet-only banks) was 4.3 trillion won, a decrease of 100 billion won year-on-year. The net profit of specialized banks (such as Industrial Bank of Korea, Export-Import Bank of Korea, IBK Enterprise Bank, and NH NongHyup Bank) was 2.4 trillion won, down 300 billion won from the same period last year. <<> While interest income increased, the non-interest income (fees, securities, and foreign exchange related) of all domestic banks in the first quarter totaled 1.3 trillion won, a significant decrease of 700 billion won from 2 trillion won in the same period last year. In particular, gains from securities-related activities turned from 2.4 trillion won in Q1 last year to -1.2 trillion won this Q1, falling into deficit. Due to rising market interest rates, securities valuation losses alone reached 1.8 trillion won. As of the end of March, the yield on 3-year government bonds was 3.557% annually, surging by 60.6 basis points (bp; 1bp = 0.01 percentage point) from 2.951% at the end of last year. <<> Meanwhile, as the won-dollar exchange rate (based on daytime trading closing price) averaged 1,466.90 won in the first quarter, up from 1,452.91 won in the same period last year, foreign exchange and derivative-related gains earned by all domestic banks in Q1 reached 2.3 trillion won. <<> By Cho Gye-wan, Senior Reporter kyewan@hani.co.kr ( 국내 전체 은행의 지난 1분기 당기순이익은 6조7천억원으로, 전년동기 대비 3천억원(3.9%) 감소했다. 이 중에 일반은행(시중·지방·인터넷전문은행)의 순이익은 4조3천억원으로 전년동기 대비 1천억원 감소했다. 특수은행(산업·수출입·IBK기업·NH농협 등)의 순이익은 2조4천억원으로 전년 동기 대비 3천억원 감소했다.)
